title: 1 Kings 18:44-46 — A small cloud, heavy rain, and Elijah outruns Ahab
summary: The text of 1 Kings 18:44-46: at the seventh time the servant sees a cloud as small as a man's hand rising from the sea, Elijah tells him to warn Ahab to go down before the shower, the sky grows black with clouds, wind and heavy rain, Ahab rides to Jezreel, and the hand of the LORD is on Elijah so that he girds up his loins and outruns Ahab to Jezreel. The names LORD and Elijah are coloured.

text.text: 44 It came about at the seventh time, that he said, “Behold, a cloud as small as a man’s hand is coming up from the sea.” And he said, “Go up, say to Ahab, ‘Prepare your chariot and go down, so that the heavy shower does not stop you.’”
45 In a little while the sky grew black with clouds and wind, and there was a heavy shower. And Ahab rode and went to Jezreel.
46 Then the hand of the LORD was on Elijah, and he girded up his loins and outran Ahab to Jezreel.

numbers.note: the cloud appears at the seventh time
